_about: Logos for datasets whose DATS.json has no logo of its own. Keys are Portal dataset ids (the /dataset?id= value). Each entry gives either img (a file under app/static/) or url, plus label, source (where the image came from), why (why this logo identifies the dataset) and tier (A: project, lab or organisation logo; B: institution mark only; C: hosting-service mark). A logo in the dataset's own DATS.json always wins over this file.

_about_remote_copies: Local copies of logos that DATS records (or url entries above) give as a URL, keyed by that URL. The Portal serves the copy instead of linking to the other site, so the logo stays visible when that site is down or moves. Adding one: save the image under app/static/img/datasets/remote/ and add the URL here; no DATS change needed. A URL with no copy here is still linked as before.
